title: Prospective TT-Use Semantic Attribution Graph, Cutoff/Move-Ordering/Evaluation-Reuse Event Instrumentation, Root-Decision Provenance, Counterfactual Search-Path Certificates & Faithful Move-Level Chess-Engine Explanation Compiler

objective.primary: identify which semantic uses of TT information are counterfactually relevant to the engine's root decision under a fixed warmed-TT history
objective.explainer: compile machine-checkable and human-readable move-level explanations from normalized TT-use events plus measurement-only semantic interventions

support.source: P30 inherited pressure-probe support; no outcome-conditioned reselection

normalized_semantics.low_ply_event_witness: retain deterministic first 128 semantic events with ply<=4 per measurement search; aggregate all events exactly

intervention_family.measurement_only: semantic masks activate only when TT search sequence == 5; prime/decoy history is native and identical across arms

semantics.NO_CUTOFF: prevent TT-derived early returns while preserving probe, move ordering, and eval reuse
semantics.NO_MOVE: remove TT move only from move-ordering/singular-IIR semantic use in measurement search; preserve cutoff and eval reuse
semantics.NO_EVAL: prevent stored evaluation and TT-value-as-evaluation reuse; preserve cutoff and move ordering
semantics.compound: pairwise and all-class masks expose interactions without attributing interaction effects to a single class

intervention_family.no_replacement_intervention: P31 does not edit TT replacement, age, indexing, or stored entry contents

exact_dependence.pv: normalized PV string differs from BASE
exact_dependence.search_path: nodes or depth differs from BASE

root_provenance.interaction: a compound mask changes root output when neither corresponding single mask does

edges: OBSERVED_USE: normalized event occurred under BASE
SINGLE_CLASS_EFFECT: removing one class changed a frozen root readout
INTERACTION_EFFECT: compound removal changed a root readout beyond its singles
attribution_graph.no_specific_event_causation: class-level ablation cannot identify a unique individual TT event as the cause unless a later event-targeted replay is performed

compiler_rules: A class may be described as observed only if BASE event count > 0.
A class may be described as root-move necessary under this frozen replay only if its single-class removal changes bestmove.
PV/score/search-path dependence must be stated separately from bestmove dependence.
Interaction-only effects must not be rewritten as single-class causes.
No human intention, plan, or strategic motive may be inferred from engine-computation provenance.

literature.causal_abstraction_use: distinguish low-level event observation from interventionally supported higher-level causal explanation

claim_ceiling: P31 identifies semantic-class dependence under a fixed node budget and warmed-TT history, not game-theoretic necessity across all searches.
Removing a semantic class globally during the measurement search changes many downstream nodes; class-level dependence is not unique-event attribution.
Node-count changes can alter which nodes are reached under a fixed node budget, so root-output effects are properties of the frozen search procedure.
Explanation text is faithful only to certificate fields and does not claim human-like strategic intent.
Support is the inherited 16 pressure-probe worlds at 1 MiB; no population-wide engine claim is authorized.
